name: Ann Weldon
bio: Ann Weldon (February 28, 1933 - January 14, 2024) was an American singer and actress. She appeared in guest roles in numerous television series and starred in the short-lived 1980 sitcom One in a Million as Edna Simmons. Some of her best-known films are Shampoo (1975), Bird (1988), and What's Cooking? (2000). Her siblings Charles Weldon and Maxine Weldon were also performers.
